scripts.dev:localstack: cross-env AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:4566 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_SESSION_TOKEN= bun run dev
scripts.dev:rustfs: cross-env AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://localhost:9000 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_SESSION_TOKEN= bun run dev
scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run python -m fastapi dev src/main.py --port 8000 --reload
scripts.fix:api: cd api && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.lint:api: cd api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.mypy: cd api && uv run python -m mypy .
scripts.test:api: cd api && cross-env PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m pytest
scripts.seed: cd api && uv run python scripts/seed_data.py
